title: Redesign prototype model passes fourteen offline role and renewal tests
summary: Fourteen offline prototype tests passed for wallet/funding reconciliation, forecast gaps, repeated offer cycles with different validity, draft exclusion, saved manager preferences, portfolio mutation limits, supplier override reasons, pause/resume policy, immutable in-progress attempts, protected unresolved amounts without double counting, missing-date disclosure, catalog/budget review, registered versus connected SIMs, format-only recipient limits, assignment/history ownership and invalid numeric controls. The new fixture offers are illustrative cards inspired by the owner-provided screenshot; they are not verified live eligibility or prices. A self-contained redesigned preview has been built using the existing DVendo theme and custom mark. Browser layout and interaction checks are next. No live account, OTP, payment or deployment occurred.

evidence.description: Synthetic role, SIM, promo-plan and forecast model.
Fourteen in-process Node tests using synthetic data.
Builds a standalone preview without editing production source or including API connectivity.

nextSteps: Verify desktop/mobile layouts, keyboard navigation and the complete manager-to-supplier workflow in a browser.
